| Category = Sweet potato recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]], peeled and cut into ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pieces
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ½ cup freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] juice
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], cut into pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
#Cover potatoes in a large pot with cold water by at least an inch.
#Cover and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat. Reduce heat to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] and cook until potatoes are tender (about 15–20 minutes).
#Drain potatoes into a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]]. Remove water from pot and add potatoes and remaining ingredients. Mash potatoes with either an immersion [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or potato masher.
#If you used a potato masher, combine ingredients thoroughly. If you did not, then you can skip this step.
#Serve immediately.
